text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Excuse me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're on edge. What's 
wrong?

If you're a sprinter, this is the pinnacle 
stage that everyone dreams of standing on, 
at least once. This is a race I really 
want her to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll win it. Because I'm the class 
president.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we've got to get back on track 
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little off the Bakushin Road that I 
started out on…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With my overwhelming speed, I'll win this 
Sprinters Stakes in a world record!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then, we'll head to the Tenno Sho and 
Arima Kinen, as originally planned!

…She wants to call it quits on short 
distances, once and for all.

But I'd love to see her run next year, 
when she'll be even faster than she is 
now. How to convince her…… Ah, over there.
(Knock, knock)
Um, is it okay if I come in now…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, go right ahead! We'll take you 
any time at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hello, Ms. Bakushin O.

Nishino Flower. A sprinter who debuted at 
the same time as Sakura Bakushin O. She's 
a talented Uma who is rapidly making a 
name for herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oya, Ms. Nishino Flower! Welcome to the 
class president's humble abode!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What can I do for you? You can count on me 
for anything at all―and don't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I just wanted to say hello to 
you…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is it about today's race? If so, ask me 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll give advice to my rivals, because I'm 
an honor student!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uuuh… um, I'm glad to hear you're doing 
well!

Her meek demeanor belies the fact that she 
has great speed. She'll be Bakushin's 
biggest rival in today's race.

Competing against Nishino Flower will 
surely be an inspiration for Sakura 
Bakushin O. I can't wait to see it!
choice_data_list: Do your best today, both of you.
Do your best today, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get to it! For the sake of 
going down the Bakushin Road…!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Road? …What is that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's the path the class president will 
take!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …? Is, is that… so?
…I'm looking forward to this!
